title: Codebook wording review: Each activity on a page (part 2 of 3)
background:
Review round 4 of the codebook wording. You chose on 30 October that agents draft the missing value definitions and you review every wording slot here. This page covers **each activity on a page**, part 2 of 3.

Each card is one codebook item. Open "Show the wording slots" to read them. Each slot is labelled with where its text came from:

- **Plan text**
- **New agent draft (round 4)**
- **Option text you chose in round 3**
- **Agent edit of the signed questionnaire**
- **Text you approved on 30 October**
- **Old production text (version 2.5): rewrite or delete**

Answer per item: approve all, approve with line-edits or deletions in the comments (by slot number), or ask for a redraft. Deletion is open only for old version-2.5 slots and for one slot of each overlap pair. The batch card at the top approves everything you leave unmarked. No recommendation is given on any wording.

New agent drafts carry a certainty mark; those marked **Needs your decision** rest on no ruling or text for some point.

items.title: target users
items.situation:
Question: Who interacts with the GenAI system.

Recorded per activity.

9 slots: 1 × old production text (version 2.5): rewrite or delete; 4 × new agent draft (round 4); 1 × plan text; 1 × text you approved on 30 October; 1 × option text you chose in round 3; 1 × agent edit of the signed questionnaire.
items.body:
**1. Question** — Old production text (version 2.5): rewrite or delete · may be deleted
Who interacts with the GenAI system.

**2. Value `internal_staff`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Only the institution's own staff use the tool.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**3. Value `public`** — New agent draft (round 4)
People outside the institution use the tool: members of the public, residents or businesses.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**4. Value `both`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Both the institution's staff and people outside it use the tool. On long pages, one part naming staff and another the public also gives this value.
_Draft certainty: high._

**5. Value `unknown`** — New agent draft (round 4)
The page mentions who uses the tool but does not let it be settled.
_Draft certainty: high._ _Note: The code `unknown` is also a reserved missing-answer label; template check 8 says a value code never equals one. You may want this value dropped in favour of the reserved label._

**6. Rule** — Plan text, from review round 1
target_users only for tool activities (`not_applicable` otherwise). A04 for governance.

**7. Long-page rule (mapping, other lists)** — Text you approved on 30 October
Drop 'not covered by this part' and missing labels from the list. 'both' present, or staff and public both present, gives 'both'. One real value gives that value. No real value: not_documented if any part says the page is silent, else unknown. Every part 'not covered' gives not_documented.

**8. Long-page rule** — Option text you chose in round 3
List all answers, then map the list to one value.

**9. Long-page rule** — Agent edit of the signed questionnaire
combined_list over the parts' answers, with {internal_staff, public} read as `both`

items.situation:

11 slots: 5 × new agent draft (round 4); 1 × plan text; 4 × option text you chose in round 3; 1 × text you approved on 30 October.
items.body:
**1. Value `prohibits`** — New agent draft (round 4)
The rule bans the GenAI use it covers, with no use allowed.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**2. Value `restricts_with_conditions`** — New agent draft (round 4)
The rule allows use only under conditions (for example approval, training, limits on data, or human review), or bans some uses and allows others. On long pages, a ban in one part and a permission in another also give this value.
_Draft certainty: high._

**3. Value `permits`** — New agent draft (round 4)
The rule allows the use without conditions.
_Draft certainty: high._

**4. Value `requires`** — New agent draft (round 4)
The rule makes GenAI use mandatory for some task or for some staff.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**5. Value `promotes`** — New agent draft (round 4)
The rule encourages or supports GenAI use without making it mandatory.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**6. Rule** — Plan text, from review round 2
One classifier question on governance activities only: prohibits, restricts with conditions, permits, requires or promotes, unknown; not applicable otherwise; with a supporting quote. The new column costs two version steps, test pages built from past governance cases, and a re-pilot.

**7. Rule** — Option text you chose in round 3
Two values, "requires" and "promotes"

**8. Rule** — Option text you chose in round 3
"Permits" only when use is allowed without conditions; across parts, a ban in one part and a permission in another also becomes "restricts with conditions" (a mapping step).

**9. Rule** — Option text you chose in round 3
A silent page gets "not documented"; a page that mentions the matter but cannot be settled gets "unknown".

**10. Long-page rule (rank of requires vs promotes)** — Text you approved on 30 October
Order: restricts_with_conditions, prohibits, permits, requires, promotes, not_documented, unknown.

**11. Long-page rule (mapping)** — Option text you chose in round 3
"Permits" only when use is allowed without conditions; across parts, a ban in one part and a permission in another also becomes "restricts with conditions" (a mapping step).

Running government itself: executive and legislative bodies, financial, fiscal and tax affairs, foreign affairs, and general administration and internal services. The earlier value 'general administration' is coded here.
_Draft certainty: medium._ _Note: Check every COFOG gloss against the official text before signing._

**2. Value `defence`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Military and civil defence.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**3. Value `public_order_safety`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Police, fire protection, the courts and prisons.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**4. Value `economic_affairs`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Economic, commercial and labour affairs; agriculture, forestry and fishing; fuel and energy; industry and construction; transport; communication.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**5. Value `environmental_protection`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Waste and waste-water management, pollution control, and the protection of biodiversity and landscape.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**6. Value `housing_community_amenities`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Housing and community development, water supply and street lighting.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**7. Value `health`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Medical products, outpatient and hospital services, and public health services.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**8. Value `recreation_culture_religion`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Recreation and sport, culture, broadcasting and publishing, and religious and other community services.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**9. Value `education`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Education at every level, from pre-primary to university, and services that support it.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**10. Value `social_protection`** — New agent draft (round 4)
Support in sickness and disability, old age, for survivors, families and children, in unemployment, for housing, and against social exclusion.
_Draft certainty: medium._

**11. Value `other`** — New agent draft (round 4)
An area that fits none of the ten areas above.
_Draft certainty: high._ _Note: The value has no label yet (fold-log round 3 §4 item 9)._

**12. Rule** — Plan text, from review round 2
One classifier question per activity over a short list of areas plus 'general administration' and 'unknown'. The new column costs two version steps and a re-pilot.

**13. Rule** — Option text you chose in round 3
The UN and Eurostat classification of the functions of government, top level (as used by Public Sector Tech Watch)

**14. Rule** — Option text you chose in round 3
Activities that fit no area get "other".

**15. Rule** — Option text you chose in round 3
The question becomes a tick-all-that-apply list.

**16. Rule** — Option text you chose in round 3
A silent page gets "not documented"; a page that mentions the matter but cannot be settled gets "unknown".

**17. Rule** — Text you approved on 30 October
No separate value. A rule says the earlier 'general administration' is coded 'general public services'.

**18. Long-page rule (multi select vs single winner)** — Text you approved on 30 October
Take every area any part ticks with a supported answer. Each area's quote and certainty come from the part most sure of it. Missing labels only if no part ticks a real area.
